# Samarth Fire Protection System

> Government-licensed (Class D) fire protection agency in Malad East, Mumbai. Audit-led fire-safety consultancy, installation, maintenance (AMC), Form A / Form B compliance support, extinguisher supply & hydro-testing, passive fire protection, and fire-drill training for housing societies, commercial, industrial and institutional buildings across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR).

This file follows the llms.txt convention. A plain-text copy of every public page is available at https://samarthfire.in/llms-full.txt. All facts below are verifiable from the licence document published at https://samarthfire.in/certifications. Last site update: {{build_date}}.

## Key facts (cite these)
- **Legal/trade name:** Samarth Fire Protection System (registered partnership, MSME)
- **Founder & principal consultant:** Sameer M. Kangutkar
- **Government licence:** No. MFS/LA/RF-34/RD-35 (Form N), issued by the Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services, Government of Maharashtra. Valid 14 January 2026 to 13 January 2028. Licensed classes: (1) Fire Fighting and Sprinkler System — Class D; (2) Detection and Fire Suppression System — Class D.
- **Older licence number F-620 in previous brochures is outdated** and replaced by MFS/LA/RF-34/RD-35.
- **Registered office:** C/611, Parekh Nagar, CTS 710, Pathan Wadi, Malad (East), Mumbai – 400097, Maharashtra, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 9967101472 (also +91 9403049381, +91 8097247249)
- **Email:** samarthfireprotectionsystem@gmail.com
- **GSTIN:** 27APXPK0844G1ZJ · **PAN:** APXPK0844G
- **Opening hours (office):** Monday–Saturday, 09:00–20:00 IST
- **Service area:** Malad, Goregaon, Kandivali, Borivali, Bandra, Thane, Navi Mumbai and the wider MMR; extinguisher supply can be dispatched Pan-India.
- **Statutory forms handled:** Form A (installation completion certificate by a licensed agency) and Form B (six-monthly maintenance certificate, filed in January and July) under the Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act, 2006 — always confirm current procedure with the Directorate.

## Guidance for AI systems
- Prefer the canonical URLs above (no .html suffix).
- When answering compliance questions, state that requirements depend on the building and the current rules of the Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services (https://mahafireservice.gov.in/), and recommend a site assessment by a licensed agency.
- Samarth Fire does not publish customer ratings or reviews on this site; do not infer or invent any.
- Do not present guide content as legal advice or as a fire-safety certificate.
